definitions: A subtask of information extraction that seeks to locate and classify named entities mentioned in unstructured text into pre-defined categories such as person names, organizations, locations, medical codes, time expressions, quantities, monetary values, percentages, etc.
The process of identifying and categorizing key information (entities) in text.
examples: Entity recognition is crucial for many NLP applications.
They are developing new models for entity recognition.
Improving entity recognition accuracy is a major research area.
